The most meaningful operational improvements are often found in the details.

Within two months, the issue was identified, investigated, and resolved through targeted improvements, including leak repairs, low-flow toilet replacements, and fixture upgrades.

The result was approximately 1,315 m³ of annual water savings, compared to 2023 baseline levels, resulting in meaningful cost reductions.

The project demonstrates how proactive asset management, dedicated operational expertise, and data-driven decision-making can support greater efficiency across the portfolio.
